title: Complete furnished plans for all eighteen room types
body:
## Current integration scope

Twenty furnished plans cover all eighteen released room types on the full-square wall stack. The branch preserves canonical footprints, cost quotes, collision checks, normal/mirrored layouts, worker construction, Undo/Redo transactions and Save/Load. The durable evidence ledger is `docs/design/2026-09-28-adjustable-camera/README.md`.

This also integrates angled picking and full-preview fitting, keyboard plan selection/rearming, authored models and Build thumbnails, camera input repairs, and the first-Cell procurement bootstrap from #1750/#1751. This is a dependent draft based on #1898, not a production release.

## Verified player acceptance

- Earlier forty cases cover twenty normal/mirrored plans and Save/Load; later additions have their own acceptance, not a claim of one freshly green entire suite.
- Full HD Yard exercise station, bench and waste bin: real Build, worker completion, footprint/cost/collision and authored pixels after Save/Load. Asset-mapping mutations fail and restorations pass.
- Common Room bench, Classroom chairs and Storage Room racks: real worker construction and authored pixels retained after Save/Load; independent consumer mutations fail. Original 60-second test and 10-second assertion limits remain.
- Cell cot: existing 1x2 identity, 72 poses, actual completion and Save/Load retain 1212 blanket pixels; old mapping mutation fails and restoration passes.
- Dense toilet: source/export fits the authoritative 1x1 square, 72 deterministic poses, actual worker-built anchor22,9 and Save/Load retain141 glaze pixels. Missing-asset consumer mutation fails at0; restoration passes2/2. Root inspected the loaded Full HD image.
- #1951 live native World/Angled selector: same unsaved worker, snapshot, commands and centre square across roundtrip;503 retry and partial-activation rollback. Late shutdown registration mutation leaks game listeners and fails; restoration passes3/3.
- #1953 Build target: complete square count/origin/catalogue value at1920x1080,2560x1080 and effective960x540 CSS viewport, without shifting following controls. Production nowrap mutation fails; restoration passes3/3. CSS size does not claim browser chrome zoom was changed.
- #1950 middle-button pan and #1954 mixed-button ownership: actual camera movement and Load safety; movement/session reset/LMB ownership mutations fail and restorations pass. Armed Build sends no unintended orders during camera gestures.
- #1946 pending preflight reopen withdraws old verdict/collision marks. #1947/#1948 cancel outgoing plans and reframe New only after incoming world state. Actual production mutations fail and restorations pass.
- Catalogue thumbnails, selected occupied rectangles and legend ink: actual keyboard/404/shape/color checks with mutations and restorations.
- #1939 keyboard object selection, held-arrow focus handling, and first Cell with zero prisoners have actual production regressions and restoration evidence. Carrier-guard mutation stalls18 orders; restored two-stage IndexedDB artifact passes.

All evidence and screenshots are preserved in dated `docs/research/2026-10-02-*` records. Root's latest target/token/index checks pass92/92, application/tools TypeScript and production artifact build pass. This does not claim a new entire-suite pass or production deployment.

## Owner approvals recorded2026-10-02

All three clickable decisions are explicitly approved: optional completed/undone history with absent-empty compatibility; optional quarterTurns/objectOrientation0..3 with absent0 compatibility; rectangular minima valid in either orientation, preserving area and other rules. The durable plan and rotation draft record them. Rotation gameplay/history, UI/preview and actual model orientation are being integrated on separate surfaces; approval is not runtime completion.
## Release gates and current work

Do not merge before the approved rotation scope is implemented/accepted, the dependency chain is satisfied and exact-head CI/mergeability plus serial main gates are green. Main angled composition/staging delivery does not release this branch or verify current production pixels.

Serial main CI36968171803 at78dc96cb9b completed successfully. PR1945 exact681e4ea0fa had all checks green and CLEAN/MERGEABLE, then merged asd2293aa8d856 on2026-10-02; resulting main CI36994796706 is live. PR1958 exact0611a66d04 is green/CLEAN but awaits this serial main gate. Integrated Laundry, Security console, Utility panel and loading dock have actual worker/SaveLoad pixel-consumer mutation/restoration proof. Bookshelf72pose export alignment is deterministic and inspected; its player baseline is prepared and pending. Layout Escape fix is tracked in#1962 and its integrated FullHD standard/angled cases pass2/2. No hosted availability claim.

## Integration checkpoint — 2026-10-02

- Owner-approved verify hydration step is applied for `assets/source/blender/*.blend,public/assets/environment/oblique/*.png`, including later models under those exact globs. Source/hash/PNG assertions and test limits are unchanged.
- The complete main-based #1898 dependency is incorporated; exact-head CI and serial-main completion remain merge gates.
- Actual Infirmary worker construction and Save/Load prove both medical consumers. Removing their art bindings fails four pixel assertions; exact rebuilt restoration passes both cases. Its accepted regression is routed through the existing artifact suite, without a new tracked config.
- Native plan transform/preflight ordering and catalogue Escape (#1965) have real built-client baselines, production mutations and exact restored passes. Paused saved mid-stride positions (#1964) and rotated pending entrance claims (#1700) are corrected using existing authoritative save data.
- Retained Canteen dining geometry now has a standalone Blender source, 72 shared-camera poses, all four footprint orientations and the existing canonical descriptor. Actual normal/rotated construction and Save/Load consumer acceptance is being completed separately.
- Local integration checks: 203 art/camera/square-wall/tint/docs checks after dependency merge; 55 rendering-feed cases; 24 dining/registry/locomotion/preview cases; 35 anchor/verbatim/index checks after entrance wiring. Both TypeScript targets and the production build passed at the documented dependency checkpoint. These are scoped results, not a claim of full current-head CI or production availability.

Durable checkpoint: [camera/building/art plan](https://github.com/woogitsu/lockstate/blob/codex/integrate-full-room-plans-20261001/docs/design/2026-09-28-adjustable-camera/README.md).
### Integrated checkpoint — 2026-10-02, c6605a6f40

- Owner-approved verify LFS hydration remains applied for Blender source files and angled PNGs; test assertions and timeout limits are unchanged.
- Fixed the sole Ubuntu verification failure with two same-paragraph ADR0116 quotations. Exact LF baseline/mutation red, restored anchor gates green, no budget/guard change.
- Accepted real-worker normal and 90-degree Canteen Build/SaveLoad screenshots and mapping-removal sensitivity. Added its case and native picker ownership case to the existing artifact gate, with complementary dev exclusions.
- Integrated #1966 modal held-key ownership and #1672 blocked entrance after Undo/later furniture. Root scoped runs:24 entrance/history cases,78 input/routing/documentation cases and201 combined art/entrance/documentation cases green; both TypeScript targets and production build green.
- Integrated retained handwash/shower authored sources and shared-camera exports; source hashes, all72 repeated poses and mutation-sensitive geometry/PNG checks preserved. Sink has an existing deliberate no-buildable boundary; actual normal/rotated Shower Room browser acceptance remains in progress.
- #1661 precise legacy entrance-edge rejection is integrated. The distinct outside-square-wall case is under actual-command investigation; it is not claimed complete here.

Previous root CI at936652289f was terminal red solely at the documentation quotation contract (6559 tests passed). Fresh exact-head full CI, dependency PR1898 browser completion and serial-main gates remain required; no production availability is claimed.
## Superseding integrated checkpoint — 2026-10-02, 0739759b0c

This checkpoint supersedes the earlier in-flight statements above; it preserves their historical evidence rather than rewriting them.

- The approved verify hydration step is applied for `assets/source/blender/*.blend` and `public/assets/environment/oblique/*.png`, including future models in these directories. Existing source, PNG, hash and timeout assertions remain unchanged.
- Dependency head `bfae195e7470bf606b27dedfcf18c5f91d7703e0` is merged into this integration ancestry. Its six terminal browser failures were reproduced and repaired by visiting every real plan control and asserting the actual plans Tab action. Production mutations were red; all six restored original cases were green. Fresh dependency browser CI is still a gate, not presumed successful.
- Completed entrance protection now requires the actual authored template door order as well as standing geometry and room purpose. Ordinary hand-built rooms are no longer incorrectly reserved. Full local pre-follow-up run: 6886 passed, two existing skips, three environment/ref-cache files failed; the unchanged three files then passed119 with existing Git Bash configured and the already published bench branch fetched. These complementary runs do not claim one entire green run.
- Occupied template Undo now reuses collective atomic relocation before removing shell or fixtures. Compatible old saves without optional completed metadata recover only an exact real order/history book with live room-purpose zoning, lazily at Undo. Refusal preserves even optional metadata; successful recovery retains saved Redo. No schema, tariff, migration, copy or history policy changes.
- Integrated actual normal/rotated worker construction, independent authored-pixel checks, IndexedDB Save/Load and consumer-removal/exact-restoration proof for Canteen dining, Infirmary, Shower, wooden bench and wooden chair. Root opened the accepted loaded FullHD images. Sink remains deliberately source-only without a buildable consumer. Generic rack native acceptance is a separate ongoing checkpoint.
- Integrated native View navigation and popup lost-release handling, modal/native picker ownership, HUD separator recognized-key ownership and native Build Category navigation. Unhandled/remapped world controls are positively preserved. The accepted cases join the existing artifact partition, without adding a separate gate or weakening limits.
- Financial audit found no new economic defect: 36 real-command transition tests cover20 room classes and saved partial delivery/refund boundaries; production quote/refund mutations failed and restored source passed. Prices remain unchanged.
- At this integrated checkpoint,232 scoped transaction/economy/HUD/chair/documentation cases passed in11 files; both TypeScript targets and production build passed. A fresh complete local suite is running on this unchanged production source. This is not exact-head remote all-green or hosted acceptance.

Release gates remain dependency completion, exact-head all-green CI, CLEAN/MERGEABLE and serial-main green. This remains a dependent draft; no production availability is claimed.
## Current release checkpoint — 2026-10-02, fa0a0331b8

This is now a draft targeting main: dependency PR1898 passed every seven exact-head remote check runs at bfae195e7470bf606b27dedfcf18c5f91d7703e0, was CLEAN/MERGEABLE and merged as48da4ac330b43b8e2a8612d8dff160f2d380f05d after the fresh serial-main gate. The actual merged ancestry and automatic0.0.838 release are incorporated. Resulting main CI and this PR's exact-head CI remain release gates.

- Approved Blender/angled-PNG verify hydration remains applied without weakening any input, assertion or timeout guard.
- The full local suite at published0739759b0c completed with7,002passed, two existing skips and596files in167.68seconds. This replaces the earlier in-flight/complementary limitation for that checkpoint, not a claim about source added later.
- Retained wooden chair and generic rack have actual native worker-built, normal/90-degree, IndexedDBLoad and default-consumer mutation/restoration proof. Their accepted artifact cases are integrated into the complementary suite partitions.
- Canonical integrated built-client run at source1b566abe78:13/13passed in5.2minutes, one worker, original limits. It covers chair/rack, HUD separator navigation, native Category filtering and world-origin key release inside Category's native popup. These are scoped actual-browser results, not the whole remote browser suite.
- Existing #1703 now rejects a later perimeter on a completed authored doorway approach before adding shell orders. Current and compatible legacy saves plus partial/complete saved Undo/Redo retain routes; ordinary manually built rooms preserve their policy.
- Existing #1705 now rejects whole-square walls on standing or pending furniture footprints, including far tiles and rotated saved construction. Legacy edge walls and actual removal remain legal. Root integration passes461 related gameplay/documentation tests in14files and both TypeScript targets.

The separate native printable typeahead case is under actual observed correction; retained desk native acceptance is a subsequent art checkpoint. No current production visual availability is claimed. Root's regular publication is verified atfa0a0331b82cebafdd737bcdb289c4ccfa9c0ad5.
### Native ownership and canonical routing — e43ec87516

Native Category printable selection now relinquishes camera-held input only on actual browser selection change, through the existing renamed keyboard ownership port. Three baseline and three producer-mutation cases fail; exact rebuilt restoration passes all8 Category navigation/popup/typeahead cases. Default behavior and unmatched remapped world control remain positive controls; same-selected-option letters and immediate-action zoom/Undo are explicitly outside this acceptance. Root integrated109 HUD/documentation/routing tests in8files and both TypeScript targets green.

Previously accepted Bookshelf, Utility panel and FullHD Layout Escape cases now join the existing artifact matcher and complementary dev exclusion. Missing only those exclusions makes the unchanged partition gate name all3 duplicate consumers; restoration passes10 partition/selection checks. Three obsolete local selector configs were removed after checking references and active consumers. No workflow, retry or timeout change.

The coherent integration head is published ase43ec87516d94d40eec12018fca8f945faed455e. The main release remains serially gated; retained desk graphics and the independently reproduced occupied explicit-cancellation boundary are under development, not claimed delivered here.
## Integrated release candidate — 3eeeddc2d276714fee6a7c8420270b78d2e49b3c

- Authored Reception desk: corrected shared-camera scale/target and all four orientations. Genuine normal/rotated construction and Save/Load acceptance: 3 restored native cases, 8 consumer-mutation pixel failures. Retained source/evaluated geometry and partial rotated occlusion are documented.
- Explicit occupied template cancellation prepares coupled relocation/refusal before any construction/refund mutation, including compatible completed metadata without Undo history. Restored 27 cases; preparation mutation 23 failures/4 controls; direct-metadata mutation 1 failure/26 controls.
- Native canvas-origin angled wall drags retain accurate held footprint and cost when crossing HUD at 100%/200%. Exact restored 4 browser cases include existing cancellation/touch controls. This fixes frozen preview, not authoritative command truncation.
- Desk and HUD-drag specs are in the existing complementary artifact/dev partition. Limits, retries and tests remain unchanged. Approved verify LFS hydration covers Blender sources and angled PNGs.
- Root combined scope: 248 passes plus 2 citation failures in 15 files; explicit external Blender `build_hash` naming and fetching the published peer origin ref restore all 8 unchanged citation checks. Final routing/research/source-anchor/citation scope: 46 tests across 6 files green. Both TypeScript targets and current production build green.
- Earlier full local 7,002-test checkpoint is historical and does not certify this newer head. Exact-head remote CI, mergeability and serial main green are still required. No hosted deployment is claimed.

Next Kitchen stove detail model, coupled cancellation refund preview and object/room native drag extension continue on separate branches so this candidate can finish CI.
